overview.title: Epoch 4.0: Unleashing Tech Creativity and Innovation
overview.summary: Epoch 4.0 is a two-day tech fest by the GitHub Community Club and DoSL at GITAM University, Bengaluru. It brings together developers, designers, gamers, and innovators for hands-on workshops, coding contests, gaming tournaments, and experience zones.
objectives: Promote technology by helping students explore, learn, and innovate across different domains.
Build teamwork and collaboration through group activities and flagship contests.
Encourage creative expression via tech challenges, games, and experience-based stalls.
Strengthen the GitHub Community at GITAM as a hub for tech enthusiasts.
Blend learning and fun so participants leave inspired, confident, and connected.

eventDetails.organizedBy: GitHub Community Club @ GITAM University & DoSL
eventDetails.targetAudience: Students from all schools at GITAM with an interest in technology, gaming, and innovation.

highlights: GeeksforGeeks-powered coding contest to sharpen problem-solving and DSA skills.
Open Source Contribution workshop to learn collaboration, PRs, and contributing on GitHub.
Tech workshop focused on Data Structures and Algorithms for interviews.
GitHub Pages workshop to build and deploy a personal portfolio or project site.
Gaming tournaments, VR booths, and nostalgia-themed setups Powered by GitHub Community.
Interactive stalls and zones where students can explore, recharge coins, and connect with peers.
